_README: Copy to fx_ai_engine/config/live_approval.json (git-ignored) and replace every placeholder. The engine refuses to start --mode live while any value below is a placeholder or the file has expired. Keys that start with an underscore are ignored by the engine.

_alternative_evidence_waiver._note: Use this block INSTEAD of 'evidence' to start without an authenticity verdict. Rename the key to 'evidence_waiver'. If both are present the waiver is used and the engine logs CRITICAL at start and every 4 hours.
_alternative_evidence_waiver.reason: REPLACE_ME: why live may start without an EVIDENCE_ELIGIBLE verdict
_alternative_evidence_waiver.accepted_by: REPLACE_ME: the person who accepts the risk

_field_notes.approved_by: Non-empty text. Name of the person who approves live trading. Written to the audit log.
_field_notes.approved_at_utc: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH a timezone (UTC recommended), for example 2026-11-05T09:00:00+00:00. Must be earlier than expires_at_utc.
_field_notes.expires_at_utc: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH a timezone. Live trading halts at this time. Keep it short (days, not months) and renew deliberately.
_field_notes.account_login: Integer MT5 account number (positive). Must equal the account the EA reports. The cent account number, not the demo one.
_field_notes.account_server: Exact MT5 server name as the EA reports it (case sensitive).
_field_notes.policy_hash: 64 lowercase hex characters. Print it with: python -m validation.print_policy_hash --mode micro_live. Any change to the micro_live policy changes the hash and needs a new approval.
_field_notes.strategy_id: Strategy the engine runs. Currently trend_pullback_v1 is the only value that passes.
_field_notes.ea_version_min: Oldest accepted EA build, format YYYY.MM.DD-N. Versions are compared as date, then build number.
_field_notes.starting_balance_usd: Number greater than 0, in US dollars. The balance at the moment of approval. Loss is measured from this value.
_field_notes.max_total_loss_usd: Number greater than 0, in US dollars. When starting_balance_usd minus account equity reaches this value the engine halts for the rest of the run (positions are not closed).
_field_notes.max_orders_per_day: Integer >= 1. The EA must report a live_guard.max_orders_per_day at or below this value.
_field_notes.max_lot_per_order: Number greater than 0, in lots (0.01 is the smallest step). The EA must report a live_guard.max_lot at or below this value.
_field_notes.evidence: Object {verdict_path, sha256}. verdict_path is an authenticity gate verdict JSON. A relative path is resolved against the fx_ai_engine/ folder, not against the current directory. sha256 is the hash of the verdict FILE bytes (shasum -a 256 <file>). The verdict must say verdict PASS, evidence_status EVIDENCE_ELIGIBLE and carry the same policy_hash as this file.
_field_notes.evidence_waiver: Object {reason, accepted_by}, both non-empty text. Starts live without a verdict. Takes precedence over 'evidence' when both are present. Every start and every 4 hours the engine logs CRITICAL and records a LIVE_EVIDENCE_WAIVER risk event.
